description.description: Sets the description of this node

errorHandler.description: Sets the error handler to use, for routes that has not already been configured with an error handler.

id.description: Sets the id of this node

intercept.description: Adds a route for an interceptor that intercepts every processing step.

interceptFrom.description: Adds a route for an interceptor that intercepts incoming messages on the given endpoint.

interceptSendToEndpoint.description: Applies a route for an interceptor if an exchange is send to the given endpoint

onCompletion.description: On completion callback for doing custom routing when the org.apache.camel.Exchange is complete.

onException.description: Exception clause for catching certain exceptions and handling them.

precondition.description: The predicate of the precondition in simple language to evaluate in order to determine if this route configuration should be included or not.
